name: click_out_index: basic match after Cancel
spec_quote: Returns the index of the first label that is, as a whole (any case, surrounding spaces ignored), one of "Apply on website", "Apply on the website", "Apply on company website", "Apply on the company website", "Apply on company's website", "Apply on the company's website".

name: click_out_index: case-insensitive with surrounding spaces (company's variant)
spec_quote: Returns the index of the first label that is, as a whole (any case, surrounding spaces ignored), one of "Apply on website", "Apply on the website", "Apply on company website", "Apply on the company website", "Apply on company's website", "Apply on the company's website".

name: click_out_index: near misses and partial phrases never count

labels: Click here to apply on website

spec_quote: Anything else never counts — "Apply", "Apply now", "Send application", "Submit", "Cancel", "Apply on website now", "Click here to apply on website", a label that only contains the phrase.

name: click_out_index: empty label list gives None
spec_quote: `labels` = the visible control labels inside the dialog, in order (strings; may be empty or missing → None).

name: opened_stop: ordinary Workday posting opened by click-out

info.title: Data Intern - Acme
info.text: Data Intern. Apply for this job. Full-time.

spec_quote: "" otherwise (an ordinary company job page: its URL is only recorded).

name: opened_stop: challenge title detected

info.title: Just a moment...
info.text: Checking your browser before accessing acme.

spec_quote: - "blocked": the title contains a challenge phrase (the list in classify step 1), or the text does and the text is shorter than 1500 characters;

spec_quote: - "signin": the url is on a Wellfound host with a sign-in path (classify step 2's list), or `password` is true (on any host — a company sign-in page);
